rules.why: The Modal is a native <dialog>, opened through showModal() - never through the open attribute: that is what traps focus and closes on Esc.
The <dialog> is named by its visible title.
Exactly one title with text and one footer with the actions.
A Modal never opens inside another.
The footer has one or two actions.
The element that opens the Modal is a button.
Inside a <form> a button without type submits.
The Modal has no X: the way out is a footer button.

manual.why: The last action is Primary or Danger.
The direct children follow the order title, content, actions, with no loose piece between them.
The main action is the last one; the first is the secondary.
aria-labelledby points to this dialog's own title, never to another one.
There is always a visible way out: data-al-*-close or <form method="dialog">.
data-al-modal-open names the id of a <dialog class="al-modal">.
Every button inside the Modal has visible text: no X, no icon-only button.
